title: Converting JS Values Directly
question: What does converting JavaScript values directly into Hazel values at the call boundary save, in time and in space? ^report(34)'s step 4; Matthew, 2026-11-03 (^ticket(681)).
measurements: New: hazeljs's Boundary benchmark (bench/boundary.mjs at 9753e44), GitHub workflow run 41693524506 on 2026-11-03, ubuntu-latest, Node 22, two rounds of four builds: per call, the median ms and the bytes allocated, for a typed and an untyped call given n*n cells, a held function reading n*n numbers, and a typed call given a handle.
